load_config_from_file: load an accelerate config from a JSON or YAML file and return the appropriate config object
create_ClusterConfig: create a ClusterConfig dataclass instance for local or cluster-based distributed training settings
create_SageMakerConfig: create a SageMakerConfig dataclass instance for Amazon SageMaker distributed training settings
convert_config_to_dict: convert a BaseConfig instance to a dictionary with enums serialized to strings
save_config_to_json_file: save a BaseConfig instance to a JSON configuration file with sorted keys and indentation
